records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

It's been a few days -- how's the setup going on your end? If you'd like a short walkthrough call, I'm happy to set one up.

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Quartz Partners
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone. Admin never replied to three outreaches (email:467ee62a, email:0d209e03, email:44411239) even after a held call (calendar:6110c19f). Silence post-call plus no tickets suggests low intent; some chance given active Starter subscription.

draft.subject: Your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Following up on our getting started call last week — I know things get busy after a kickoff. Whenever you're ready, creating one real project is the simplest place to start; in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to work through that first project with you live, or answer anything over email.

Best,
Chidi
